SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-22-2022 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANTS AND PLAINTIFF TO AUG-10-2022 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506.PLAINTIFF JEREMY BATTIS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANTS XINGWEI LU AND OREN KISLEV ARE PRESENT. HEARD WITH RELATED CASE CSM-22-865550. HONORABLE GREG GROENEVELD CONTINUES THESE CASES FOR ISSUES REGARDING BOTH THE PLAINTIFF AND THE DEFENDANTS CASES. PLAINTIFF NEEDS TO ADDRESS WHETHER HE IS THE REAL PARTY OF INTEREST, AND IF HE HAS SPLIT HIS CAUSES OF ACTION TO COME WITHIN THE JURISDICTIONAL LIMITS OF THIS COURT. THE DEFENDANTS NEED TO FOLLOW THE PROCEDURES IN CIVIL CODES OF PROCEDURE, SECTION 116.390: TO FILE A COMPLIANCE DECLARATION AND PERSONALLY SERVE THE PLAINTIFF, INCLUDED WITH THE COMPLAINT OF CASE CGC-22-600137 IN ORDER TO TRANSFER THESE CASES TO LIMITED LIABILITY COURT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: GREG GROENEVELD; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
